description: The names Epicenter gives a write in progress beside its target, which no listing, watcher, or sync describes: a save staged as `.ep-<random>.save`, and a recording as `.ep-<8 base36 characters>-<base>.recording` beside its final path `<base>.webm`. A path is reserved when its last segment matches `^\.ep-[^/]+\.(save|recording)$` with a nonempty middle. `legacyDirectory` is where older builds kept a folder's unfinished writes, which opening a folder empties and then removes. The folder core (core/src/state.rs) and @epicenter/folder both read this file.
